claims.statement: The Desktop tab now includes a multi-file scoped editor with a File Edit Queue.
The editor supports direct path open, indexed file browser, dirty draft state, Save Current, Save All, Revert Draft, Close Draft, and backup result display.
No Monaco, xterm.js, or PTY dependency was installed in this slice.
